reconstruction.reason: The production-path fixture does not exist at the preserved source commit. AC1 permits a reconstruction from that commit with the exact versioned fixture and project overlay used by the post run; both overlays and the baseline EventStore gitlink are recorded here.

measuredProductionClosure.rationale: The fixture executes ConversationAggregate.Handle, the production idempotency store, ConversationQueryHandler, ConversationProjectionReadStore, hydration, and the platform in-memory read-model implementation. These projects are the application/platform code directly exercised by those paths.

reconstruction.equivalence: The baseline and post runs use byte-identical benchmark and project overlays, the same Release toolchain, one worker, and the same frozen data/operation counts. Only the preserved baseline production sources versus the reviewed post working tree differ, which is the source delta the gate is intended to detect.
reconstruction.residualLimitation: This is an in-process warm-path gate and does not measure network or sidecar latency. Unlike the superseded toy fixture, it exercises the changed production query and projection-read code and can expose a Story 6.2 regression.

fixture.processing: elapsed Stopwatch ticks converted to microseconds per operation; P95 is nearest-rank ceil(0.95*n)
